title: How to select a specific sprite in Set Movement Route's Set Graphic

posts.author: AmeerAshourDraws
posts.body:
To add some context before I get to anything, the Set Movement Route had an option to change the graphics an event uses.
In XP, the way it worked was that not only you had the option to select the spritesheet of your choice, but also the specific sprite on the sheet the event will be. That was really helpful in animating some stuff in that one XP project I did.
Every other version of the engine after XP, including MZ, just makes you choose the spritesheet you want with no way of choosing the specific sprite you want.
I was wondering if there's a way to choose the specific sprite you want to set in MZ, be it by code or a plugin, because quite franklu, I don't like the method of turning the event around in a 360 degrees motion just to make it do a certain animation, it's really finicky for my liking.
